import kit

types = [{"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
         {"name": "C", "kind": "char"},
         {"name": "I", "kind": "int", "bits": 8}]
modules = [
    {"name": "T", "params": [["a", "I"], ["b", "C"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
     "requires": ["eq", ["var", "a"], ["const", "I", 3]]},
    {"name": "F", "params": [["x", "I"]], "result": ["res", "B"],
     "requires": ["ne", ["var", "x"], ["const", "I", 7]]},
    {"name": "G", "params": [["y", "I"]], "result": ["res", "B"],
     "requires": ["le", ["var", "y"], ["const", "I", 5]]},
    {"name": "H", "params": [["z", "I"]], "result": ["res", "B"], "requires": None},
]
pipes = [{"target": "T", "filter": "F", "bind": {"x": "a"}},
         {"target": "F", "filter": "G", "bind": {"y": "x"}}]
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": pipes,
            "entries": ["T"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
out, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
print("modules", plan["modules"], "flag", plan["flag"], "vars", plan["variables"],
      "slots", plan["slots"], "types", plan["types"])
assert plan["modules"] == ["G", "F", "T"]
assert plan["flag"] == "x3" and plan["variables"] == 4

def run(leaves, flag):
    campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "T", "ktest": kit.test_ktest(plan, leaves, flag=flag)}]
    return kit.run_cli(campaign)["records"][0]

# a=3 accepted everywhere, flag 0 -> READY
print(run([3, ord("q")], 0))
assert run([3, ord("q")], 0) == {"status": "READY", "case": 0, "model_result": False}
# flag mismatch when filters accept -> INVALID_TEST
assert run([3, ord("q")], 1) == {"status": "INVALID_TEST"}
# a=7 fails F, flag 1 -> FILTERED
assert run([7, ord("q")], 1) == {"status": "FILTERED"}
# a=7 fails F but flag claims accept -> INVALID_TEST (even though entry predicate false too)
assert run([7, ord("q")], 0) == {"status": "INVALID_TEST"}
# a=9 fails entry predicate and G (9<=5 false); flag 1 -> FILTERED
assert run([9, ord("q")], 1) == {"status": "FILTERED"}
# a=4: filters ok, entry predicate false -> FILTERED with flag 0
assert run([4, ord("q")], 0) == {"status": "FILTERED"}
# missing flag object
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "T", "ktest": kit.test_ktest(plan, [3, ord("q")], flag=0, drop=["x3"])}]
assert kit.run_cli(campaign)["records"][0]["status"] == "INVALID_TEST"

# object order does not change identity
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "T", "ktest": kit.test_ktest(plan, [3, ord("q")], 0)},
                    {"entry": "T", "ktest": kit.test_ktest(plan, [3, ord("q")], 0,
                                                           order=["x1", "x0", "x3", "x2"])}]
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
print(out["records"], out["corpus"])
assert [r["status"] for r in out["records"]] == ["READY", "DUPLICATE"]
assert out["corpus"][0]["witnesses"] == [0, 1]
print("PIPES OK")
